span.p: Annotation interface (one record per clinician and case)

color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
1. Cohorts
pilot: 70 admissions, 10 per chief complaint,
35 train / 35 test
study: 350 test admissions, 50 per chief complaint,
disease-balanced draw (seed 20260711), pilot excluded

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2. Candidate list per case
all WikiDoc diseases of the chief complaint
(19–74), ranked by cosine similarity
to the discharge diagnosis text

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
3. Automated references
cosine reference = first candidate
ICD reference = candidate whose ICD-10 pattern
matches the earliest coder ICD code

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Shown
discharge summary (admission-time sections marked),
labs, discharge diagnosis, coder ICD codes
(collapsible panels), WikiDoc help on hover

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Shown by default, can be hidden
MERLIN model ranks V1–V4 + reasoning
other clinicians' marks
clinicians were instructed to hide both;
not enforced, no interaction logs

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4. Clinician task
confirm the clinically correct diagnosis:
check one or more candidates,
or add a diagnosis missing from the list
(shared per case, stored as oN)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5. Case construction
positives = checked dN / oN
unchecked = not selected
no consensus, raters analysed separately

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6. Clinician vs references
agreement with ICD / cosine reference,
tie-break where they disagree,
recall ceiling of the candidate list

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7. Inter-rater agreement (study)
candidate-level Cohen's κ, Fleiss' κ,
exact-set agreement, Jaccard, nesting

div.style: color: rgb(17, 24, 39) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
8. Model evaluation (secondary)
Hit@k / MRR of V1–V4 against
the clinician; bootstrap 2,000, seed 12345
